# Team Billing — Work Breakdown

**Level 1 deliverable:** Team Billing subsystem (single-currency, this release)

## 1. Outline

| # | Piece | Type |
|---|-------|------|
| 1 | Team Billing Subsystem | Deliverable |
| 1.1 | Usage-Tracking Service | Work package |
| 1.2 | Billing Engine | Work package |
| 1.3 | Payment-Method Vault | Work package |
| 1.4 | Invoice Generator | Work package |
| 1.5 | Admin Dashboard (billing view) | Work package |
| 1.6 | Multi-currency support | **Deferred — gap line, not built this quarter** |

Your five pieces are all product nouns and don't overlap as named, but two of them (Billing Engine ↔ Vault, Invoice Generator ↔ delivery) have a boundary I had to resolve or flag below — see "Open items."

## 2. Dictionary

**1.1 Usage-Tracking Service**
- Scope: capture and aggregate billable usage events per account/team.
- In: event ingestion, per-period usage totals, retention/audit trail.
- Out: pricing math, invoicing, charging.
- Deliverable: service exposing queryable usage totals per billing period.
- Interfaces: feeds totals to Billing Engine.
- Acceptance: totals reconcile against raw events; Billing Engine can query a closed period.
- Size: medium. Owner: TBD. Dependencies: existing account/team identity.

**1.2 Billing Engine**
- Scope: compute the charge amount per account per period from usage + plan/rate rules.
- In: charge calculation, plan/rate lookup, proration, credits/adjustments — USD only.
- Out: multi-currency (1.6, deferred), storing/executing payment (1.3), rendering invoice (1.4), display (1.5).
- Deliverable: finalized "bill" record per account per period.
- Interfaces: consumes usage from 1.1 and plan/rate data (assumed existing, external dependency — confirm); emits finalized bill to 1.4 and a charge request to 1.3.
- Acceptance: bill amount matches hand-calculated test cases; idempotent per period (no double-billing).
- Size: large — this is the biggest work package; if one owner can't absorb rate-lookup + proration + adjustments, split it into a level-3 sub-breakdown rather than let it swell.
- Owner: TBD. Dependencies: 1.1, plan/pricing data.

**1.3 Payment-Method Vault**
- Scope: store/manage payment methods **and** execute the charge against a finalized bill.
- In: tokenized storage, CRUD on payment methods, charge execution, charge status tracking.
- Out: deciding the charge amount (1.2), displaying methods in UI (1.5 reads status only).
- Deliverable: vault service that stores methods and records charge attempts/results.
- Interfaces: receives charge requests from 1.2; calls external payment processor; returns status to 1.2/1.5.
- Acceptance: methods CRUD works; a charge request yields a recorded success/failure; no raw card data outside vault/processor boundary.
- Size: medium-large (PCI/compliance surface). Owner: TBD. Dependencies: 1.2, external payment processor.

**1.4 Invoice Generator**
- Scope: render a finalized bill into a formal invoice document.
- In: invoice numbering, line-item formatting, document generation, invoice history/storage.
- Out: computing the amount (1.2), charging (1.3), display (1.5).
- Deliverable: stored, retrievable invoice document per finalized bill.
- Interfaces: consumes bill record from 1.2; exposes documents to 1.5.
- Acceptance: every finalized bill produces exactly one invoice; line items reconcile against the bill.
- Size: medium. Owner: TBD. Dependencies: 1.2.

**1.5 Admin Dashboard (billing view)**
- Scope: internal, read-only UI to view an account's usage, bill, invoice, and charge status.
- In: list/detail views, search by account, charge status display.
- Out: editing bills, triggering charges (unless leadership wants manual override — open item below), any customer-facing view.
- Deliverable: admin billing pages.
- Interfaces: read-only calls to 1.1–1.4.
- Acceptance: an admin can pull up any account/period and see usage, bill, invoice, and charge status.
- Size: medium. Owner: TBD. Dependencies: 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4.

## 3. Gap line (write this down today)

**1.6 Multi-currency support** — deferred to a later release per leadership decision. All five pieces above are USD-only this quarter. Right now this exists only verbally; put it in your mission/non-goals doc or the change packet's scope statement so it doesn't get silently re-scoped in later.

## 4. Open items before this is fully MECE

These aren't blockers, but the five names alone don't settle them — decide and record:
1. **Invoice delivery** (emailing/sending the invoice to the customer) — not currently owned by any of the five. Fold into 1.4's scope, or is it a sixth piece?
2. **Customer-facing bill view** — you specified admin-only. Confirm customers don't need their own view this quarter (or it's another deferred-scope line like 1.6).
3. **Plan/pricing source** for 1.2 — assumed to be an existing system outside this WBS. Confirm it exists and is stable.

## Self-check
100% rule: covered, with (1) and (2) above flagged rather than silently assumed. No overlaps: charge execution assigned solely to 1.3, not 1.2. Product-first: all level-2 names are nouns. Dictionary: complete for 1.1–1.5. Leveling: all are ownable work packages except 1.2, which may need one more level of splitting.

**Next:** resolve the three open items with whoever owns the decision, add the currency non-goal to your written scope doc, assign owners to 1.1–1.5, then hand off to `organizing-project-folders` for the repo layout and to `plan.md`/stage contracts per leaf if these will be built by separate agents/sessions.
